products.title: Premium Airless Bottle 50ml
products.desc: White 50ml airless pump bottle with a clear cap. The airless pump dispenses smoothly and helps keep serums, lotions and creams fresh. Compact and easy to carry.

products.title: Premium Widemouth Airless Bottle 50ml
products.desc: White 50ml airless bottle with a wide opening that makes filling and cleaning easier. A good fit for thicker creams, gels and lotions.

products.title: Golden Ring Airless Bottle 30ml
products.desc: 30ml white airless bottle with a gold ring accent and a matching cap. A neat, upscale look for serums, lotions, creams and essences.

products.title: Premium Airless Acrylic Bottles 30ml & 50ml
products.desc: Clear acrylic airless bottles in 30ml and 50ml with a white pump, silver band and white base. Suited to serums, lotions and creams.

products.title: 30ml Frosted Glass Bottle with Pump
products.desc: 30ml square frosted glass bottle with a black pump and a matching square black cap. Suitable for oils, lotions and creams.

products.title: 30ml Frosted Glass Foundation Pump Bottle
products.desc: 30ml round frosted glass bottle with a pump and clear overcap, available with a white or black pump. For foundation, serums, lotions and primers.

products.title: Premium Foundation Pump Bottles 30ml & 50ml
products.desc: Frosted glass pump bottles in 30ml and 50ml with black or grey pumps and clear overcaps. For foundation, BB cream, serums and moisturizers.

products.title: 300ml Feeder Bottle with Lotion Pump
products.desc: 300ml glossy bottles in black and white with a lotion pump (the white one has a gold collar). For lotions, creams, shampoos, conditioners and body wash. Suited to salons, spas and home use.

products.title: Premium Lotion Bottles 100ml – 300ml
products.desc: Clear bottles in 100ml, 200ml and 300ml with a white lotion pump and gold collar. For lotions, creams, serums and body lotions.

products.title: Premium Lotion Bottle with Press Cap 200ml
products.desc: 200ml bottle with a press (disc-top) cap, in white, clear and black, with gold or silver caps. For lotions, toners, shampoos, hand wash and oils.

products.title: Premium Acrylic Pump Bottles
products.desc: Clear acrylic pump bottles with a gold or white-silver pump. Sizes: 100ml, 150ml and 200ml (the photo also shows a 120ml). For lotions, creams, serums and hand wash.

products.title: Fancy Mist Pump Bottle 100ml
products.desc: 100ml clear bottle with a black fine-mist pump and a clear cap. For toners, face mists, rose water and other liquids.

products.title: Nozzle Bottles 50ml & 100ml
products.desc: Frosted bottles in 50ml and 100ml with a white spray pump and a long nozzle. For toners, hair mists, sanitizers and skincare liquids.

products.title: Oil Nozzle Cap Bottles 100ml & 200ml
products.desc: Bottles in 100ml and 200ml with a twist-open nozzle cap, in black, clear and white. For oils, serums, tinctures and other liquids that need controlled pouring.

products.title: Premium Toner Bottles 100ml
products.desc: 100ml frosted bottle with a white screw cap and an inner stopper. For toners, mists, essences and micellar water.

products.title: Silver & Golden Serum Bottles 20ml & 30ml
products.desc: Glass serum bottles in 20ml and 30ml with a shiny silver or gold finish and a dropper. For serums, oils and lotions.

products.title: 20ml Serum Bottles
products.desc: 20ml glass serum bottles in white, black, amber and frosted glass, with gold, silver or black collars. For serums, facial oils, beard oils and hair oils.

products.title: White Shine Premium Serum Bottles 20ml & 30ml
products.desc: Glossy white glass serum bottles in 20ml and 30ml with a white dropper and silver collar. For serums, essential oils and skincare.

products.title: Coloured Flat Head Serum Bottles 30ml
products.desc: 30ml flat head dropper bottles in black, mint green, pink, aqua blue and white. For serums, essential oils and skincare.

products.title: Premium Roll On Bottle 10ml
products.desc: 10ml amber glass roll-on bottle with a roller ball and a black cap. For essential oils, attars, perfumes and serums. The photo also shows amber dropper versions.

products.title: Eye Roller Bottle 10ml
products.desc: 10ml eye roller bottle in silver and gold finish with a stainless steel roller ball and a clear cap. For eye serums, oils and essentials.

products.title: Frosted Candle Jar 200gm
products.desc: 200gm frosted glass jar with a silver metal lid. For soy, paraffin and gel candles, home décor and gifting.

products.title: PET Jars 150ml, 200ml & 250ml
products.desc: Clear wide-mouth PET jars in 150ml, 200ml and 250ml with silver screw lids. For body scrubs, creams, gels, butters and hair masks.

products.title: Black Aluminium Tins 10gm & 30gm
products.desc: Matte black aluminium tins in 10gm and 30gm with screw lids. For lip balms, salves, creams and solid perfumes.

products.title: Premium Majoon Jar 100gm (frosted plastic)
products.desc: 100gm frosted plastic jar with a cork lid and a matching spoon. For majoon, herbs, tablets and powders.

products.title: Premium Majoon Jar, Gold & Silver (glass)
products.desc: Glass majoon jars with an embossed gold or silver metal finish and lid. For majoon, herbal and Unani products, churan, balm and dry fruits. A good gifting option.

products.title: Lip Gloss Tubes 5ml & 10ml
products.desc: Clear 5ml and 10ml squeeze tubes with a soft applicator tip and a cap. For lip gloss, lip oil, lip serum and tinted gloss.

products.title: Lipgloss & Mascara Tubes
products.desc: Square clear tubes with gold or black caps. Lip gloss tube: 6ml, doe-foot wand, 11.2 cm tall, 2.1 cm wide. Mascara tube: 10ml, fibre brush, 12.5 cm tall, 2.1 cm wide.

products.title: Sun Block Bottle 50ml
products.desc: 50ml pill-shaped bottle in sage green and white with a sun design on the cap. For sunscreen and skincare formulas. Compact and easy to carry.

products.title: Premium Salt Grinders
products.desc: Glass grinder bottles with steel or black tops and a ceramic grinding core. Adjustable from fine to coarse, with a wide opening for easy refilling. For salt, pepper and spices.
